projects.name: Voxel-Based Rendering Engine
skills: C#
OpenGL
points: Developed a voxel rendering engine using C# and OpenGL capable of generating and displaying worlds containing approximately 4 million blocks
Designed a chunk-based world system using 32x32x32 block chunks, with chunks dynamically generating around the player
Implemented procedural mesh generation using bitwise operations to determine adjacent blocks and visible faces, including adjacency checks across chunk boundaries
Optimized block storage through run-length-style compression, reducing memory usage for repeated block data
Optimized CPU-to-GPU data transfer through bitpacking, encoding vertex position, UV, and ambient occlusion data into 32-bit integers for reconstruction in the vertex shader
Achieved 3000+ FPS with the full finite world visible on screen through rendering, memory, and CPU/GPU transfer optimizations
reduced unnecessary geometry through face visibility checks and OpenGL backface culling
Developed a dynamic texture atlas stitching system that combined arbitrary image assets from a given directory into a single texture atlas for rendering
Implemented the infrastructure for per-vertex ambient occlusion data using additional bitpacked vertex data
